param: π Human population birth/recruitment rate
k Fraction of human recruitment vaccinated at birth (vaccination rate parameter in paper)
μ₁ Natural death rate of humans
μ₂ Natural death rate of mosquitoes
θ Rate of vaccine immunity loss (V_H → S_H)
ε Vaccine efficacy/leakiness factor modifying infection of vaccinated humans (appears as β₁ ε)
β₂ Effective rate moving susceptible humans to vector-exposed class E_H1 (mosquito-borne exposure term in equations)
α₂ Effective rate moving susceptible humans to non-vector-exposed class E_H2 (non-vector exposure term in equations)
β₁ Effective rate moving vaccinated humans to vector-exposed class E_H1 (appears as β₁ ε V_H)
α₁ Effective rate moving vaccinated humans to non-vector-exposed class E_H2
τ₁ Progression rate from vector-exposed humans E_H1 to infectious humans I_H
τ₂ Progression rate from non-vector-exposed humans E_H2 to infectious humans I_H

σ Progression rate from infectious humans to treated humans (I_H → T_H)
ω Recovery rate from treated humans to recovered humans (T_H → R_H)
γ Loss of natural immunity rate (R_H → S_H)
Λ Mosquito recruitment/birth rate
β₃ Effective rate moving susceptible mosquitoes to exposed mosquitoes (S_M → E_M)
φ Progression rate from exposed mosquitoes to infectious mosquitoes (E_M → I_M)
ηS Effective contact rate of susceptible humans with infected mosquitoes (table/figure narrative; not explicitly used in ODEs as provided)
ηV Effective contact rate of vaccinated humans with infected mosquitoes (table/figure narrative; not explicitly used in ODEs as provided)
ξS Effective contact rate of susceptible humans with infected humans via non-vector pathways (table/figure narrative; not explicitly used in ODEs as provided)
ξV Effective contact rate of vaccinated humans with infected humans via non-vector pathways (table/figure narrative; not explicitly used in ODEs as provided)
ρ Effective contact rate of susceptible mosquitoes with infected humans through blood meals (table; corresponds conceptually to β₃ in ODEs)
